Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

entries.description: One entry per requested DID that the caller may read and that serves at least one name, in request order. A DID that is not hosted here, that the caller may not read, or that serves no name is absent — the three are indistinguishable.

names.description: Served (enabled) agent names as `{domain}/@{name}` addresses. Parked names are not served and are not listed; did-management/agent-name/list shows them to the owner.
